config.label: The only Android target the process may use
config.description: The only Android target the process may use. Required when ADB reports more than one authorized device; the server refuses to guess.

config.label: Explicit path to the ADB executable
config.description: Explicit path to the ADB executable. Falls back to ANDROID_SDK_ROOT, ANDROID_HOME, then PATH.

config.label: Confines host paths used by APK installation and file push/pull
config.description: Confines host paths used by APK installation and file push/pull. Defaults to the process working directory.

config.label: Numeric PIN for UI actions that require automatic unlock
config.description: Numeric PIN for UI actions that require automatic unlock.

config.label: Set to 1 to publish the arbitrary shell and macro tools
config.description: Set to 1 to publish the arbitrary shell and macro tools. Grants authority equivalent to broad ADB shell access.

config.label: Path to a persistent debug log
config.description: Path to a persistent debug log. File logging is otherwise disabled.

config.label: Tracing filter
config.description: Tracing filter. Defaults to warn, or debug when a debug log path is set.

config.label: Set to 1 to start the long-running device event monitor
config.description: Set to 1 to start the long-running device event monitor. Requires DROIDSIGHT_DEVICE_SERIAL.

config.label: Set to 1 to start the background enforcement loop
config.description: Set to 1 to start the background enforcement loop. It re-applies watched device state on a timer, including unlocking the screen. Off by default.
